rhs.description: A medium-sized bushy deciduous shrub, to 3m, with leaf colour varying at different seasons, yellow in spring, greenish in summer and orange-yellow in autumn. The bark is bright green and reddish-purple flowers in summer may be followed by red fruits

attributes.suggested_uses: City/Courtyard Gardens, Low Maintenance, Patio/Container Plants, Architectural, Cottage/Informal Garden, Rock Garden
attributes.hort_group_description: Acers in this palmatum group have small, palm-shaped leaves with coarsely-toothed edges

care.cultivation: Grow in a moist but well-drained soil. Water in summer if necessary. Leaf colour is best in partial shade, although full sun can be tolerated. Leaf scorch can be caused by lack of soil moisture or excessive exposure
care.propagation: Propagate by grafting or softwood cuttings

resistance.pest: May be susceptible to Acer gall mite, aphids , caterpillars and horse chestnut scale
resistance.disease: May be susceptible to Verticillium wilt , Acer leaf scorch and honey fungus

attributes.hort_group_description: 本 palmatum 组的槭树叶片较小，呈掌状，边缘具粗锯齿。

care.cultivation: 宜种植于湿润但排水良好的土壤中。夏季如有需要应浇水。叶色在半阴环境下表现最佳，但也可耐全日照。土壤水分不足或暴露过度都可能导致叶片焦枯。
care.propagation: 可采用嫁接或软枝扦插繁殖

resistance.pest: 可能易受槭瘿螨、蚜虫、毛虫和七叶树介壳虫危害
resistance.disease: 可能易感黄萎病、槭叶焦枯病和蜜环菌病

rhs_zh.description: 中等大小、丛生状落叶灌木，高可达 3 米；叶色随季节变化，春季黄色，夏季带绿色，秋季橙黄色。 树皮鲜绿色，夏季开红紫色花，之后可能结红色果实。

descriptions_zh.preferred: 这个优美的品种由意大利米兰附近的 Fratelli Gilardelli 苗圃于 20 世纪 80 年代后期引入，是近年一批因清新春叶色而被选育的 Acer palmatum 品种之一。 其新叶萌发时呈清新的橙色，很快转为柠檬黄色，叶缘与叶尖带橙色晕染。 它与广受欢迎的 'Katsura' 相似，但展叶不那么早，因此较不易遭受早春寒潮伤害。 此外，其叶片鲜黄色保持时间更久，直到夏末仍缓慢转为黄绿色，叶缘往往还略带淡红色。 秋季则转为明亮的金黄色。 细长的新梢颜色由悦目的红色到浅绿色不等，仅有淡淡的条纹。 七裂叶略宽于长，长 4 至 7 厘米、宽 4. 5 至 8 厘米，裂片分裂深度达叶基的约 2/3 至 3/4。 卵形裂片具短尾状尖端，长 3. 5 至 5. 5 厘米，中部宽 2 至 2. 5 厘米，向先端渐狭。 估计成熟后株高可达 3 至 4 米。 与大多数浅色叶品种一样，以半阴环境栽培最佳，且不宜失水干旱，否则叶片可能皱缩。 不过，它已被证明比

products.title: Acer palmatum 'Orange Dream' Japanese Maple
products.description_text: Acer palmatum 'Orange Dream' Orange Dream Yellow Japanese Maple Tree Zones 5-9 'Orange Dream' is a beautiful Japanese maple with exceptional color. The leaves of 'Orange Dream' leaf out in the early spring with bright golden leaves that are outlined in bright orange red. This color contrast is striking. 'Orange Dream' can also be used to brighten dark spots in the garden. In hotter climates, we recommend giving 'Orange Dream' protection from the hot afternoon sun for best color. Fall colors are bright oranges to red. 'Orange Dream' is an Italian introduction from Gilardelli Nursery. 'Orange Dream' may reach 10 ft in 15 years becoming denser and more shrub-like with time.
